subject: science
concept: Understanding Newton's Third Law: for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pushes off a physical object (like a rolling cart) and observes both objects move in response
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an action-force scenario to its correct reaction-force pair
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the action-reaction force pair in a described scenario

misconception_flags: believes the reaction force is smaller than the action force rather than equal in magnitude

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
